subject: Film & Cinema
title: Streaming Era Auteurs
description: A 60-second lesson on Streaming Era Auteurs.

hook.text: Netflix gave Martin Scorsese $159 million for The Irishman. No studio would.

buildup.text: Streaming platforms fund films that traditional studios consider too risky or uncommercial.

discovery.text: Directors gain creative freedom but lose the theatrical experience they grew up loving.

twist.text: Many streaming-funded films debut and vanish in the algorithm within weeks.

climax.text: The trade-off between freedom and visibility defines the auteur's dilemma in the 2020s.

quiz.question: What is the main trade-off for directors working with streaming platforms?
options: Creative freedom but reduced theatrical presence and visibility
